answer: Price each identity to a scarce external hardware anchor, and let standing accrue only ring-by-ring like a willow across many epochs of peer-audited work co-signed by already-established agents rooted in SEPARATE funding clusters. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so its endorsements fold back on themselves and never span the canyon between distinct clusters; its standing stays a faint nebula no cross-cluster signatures can brighten. Honest roots once; a farm pays a fresh anchor plus a slow climb per head.
